Support

QUESTIONS FROM THE LAB

Straight answers from the engineers. No fluff ? just what you need before you book.

Only best-grade TMR sticks are used where applicable. TMR is magnetic sensing ? no contact, no wear. That means no drift, true precision with clean center and no deadzone issues, and built to last through daily competitive grinding. Once you feel it, stock sticks feel broken.

BASIC ? R750: Deep clean + TMR installation + full calibration. Perfect if you just want drift-free performance. PRO ? R1700 (most popular): Deep clean + TMR + 2 remappable back buttons + calibration. ELITE ? R2500: Deep clean + TMR + 4 remappable buttons + calibration for max control. Click triggers optional +R150 extra.

Short trigger stops ? hair-trigger style ? that cut travel distance for faster shooting. Think instant ADS and faster semi-auto spam. Mechanical click, tactile snap, optional add-on on ELITE for R150. We install and tune them in lab.

If you're on PS4 / PC we still got you. T29 is Hall Effect (no drift), durable premium feel, 2 remap buttons already installed, Type-C charging with great battery life. Compatible with PS4 and PC, best generic for price at R650 ? no deposit, stock available. No need to send your controller in.

50% deposit required to start any installation as parts need to be sourced for your specific board revision. Once parts have arrived, turnaround is +-1 day. You get updates in lab queue and we test on rig before hand-off.

Yes. These loadouts are top-selling due to quality and good reviews worldwide ? proven in comp. Other mods available upon request: shell swaps, LEDs, clicky face buttons, trigger tuning, thumbstick caps and tension mods. Tell us your spec and we'll engineer it.

Delivery is free within a 15km radius of Centurion and Lenasia. Outside that, courier costs apply to customer ? we use overnight courier with tracking. Local pick-up from lab also available. We package with anti-static and foam.

Bring your own controller, we do lab work only: 2 remap buttons R1500, 4 remap buttons R1800. Both include soldering, wiring, mapping, and calibration. DIY kits from R1000 up ? dependant on kit and controller BDM revision. Message us your controller model for exact quote.
